what: Behind a vertical stack of link rows (the expanding menu panel), a dark pill the height of one row stays hidden. It then slides at .35s cubic-bezier(.27,.83,.64,1) to the position order ÷ row count of the hovered row and fills, and that row’s text and arrow flip to the background color. When you leave the rows the pill fades out in place (same .35s). Hover the next row and it slides in from the last position.

options.--fx-dur · --fx-ease: Slide and fill length and curve (via style), default .35s cubic-bezier(.27,.83,.64,1)
options.--fx-pill · --fx-on: Pill color · text color on top (via style), default --kf-contrast-bg · --kf-contrast-ink
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Row the pill follows (must be the same height to line up). If none, the element’s a child
options.[data-fx-part=pill]: Pill (optional) — if missing, create one and attach it at the front

note: The original positions each item as order / row count × 100%, assuming equal row heights — if rows differ in height, the pills misalign. Not applied on devices that cannot hover (hover is false). The original hides the pill on iOS

from.where: shared.js and shared.css header expanding panel .yd-drop__pill (original .header__linksLinkInnerHover — top: n/len*100%, background transparent↔#282621, .35s all cubic-bezier(.27,.83,.64,1), height 3.7037vw = One line)
